reason: Our cook makes fresh, delicious green chutney every week for free, so paying ₹99 for 100g of commercial sauce makes no financial or practical sense.
objection: My mother or cook already makes fresh green chutney in a dabba for free, and ₹99 for 100g is excessively expensive.
would_change_my_mind: Unless it's a unique flavour our cook can't make—like authentic Schezwan or Chilli Garlic—at under ₹60.
